query.description: Optional: Filter by specific risk register UUID

request.description:
Retrieves a comprehensive 5x5 risk heatmap with detailed risk information and supporting context for each cell.

Returns:
- Complete 5x5 matrix (25 cells)
- Each cell contains:
  - Risk count, score, rating, color
  - Array of all risks in that cell with full details
  - Category, department, owner information
  - Controls, mitigation costs, target dates
  - Risk appetite status
- Metadata: title, description, register name, date range, generation timestamp
- Summary statistics: risk distribution, average/min/max scores, appetite compliance

Use Cases:
- Executive dashboards with drill-down capability
- Risk committee reports with supporting evidence
- Compliance documentation with full audit trail
- Trend analysis (compare inherent vs residual)
- Register-specific analysis

query.description: Risk type: 'residual' shows risks AFTER controls applied

request.description:
Retrieves residual risk heatmap (risks after controls are applied). Compare with inherent heatmap to measure control effectiveness.

Rating Scale (INFRATEL Framework):
- Score 1-3: LOW (Green) - Acceptable risk appetite
- Score 4-6: MEDIUM (Yellow) - Moderate/cautious tolerance
- Score 7-15: HIGH (Orange) - Close monitoring required
- Score 16-25: VERY_HIGH (Red) - Unacceptable risk tolerance

Retrieves a detailed heatmap for risks within a specific risk register.

Includes register context:
- Register name
- Date range (start and due dates)
- Timeline status
- Total risks in register

Use for:
- Quarterly/annual risk assessments
- Department-specific risk reviews
- Time-bound risk analysis
- Progress tracking over reporting periods
